entries.name: Единая модель голов команды
entries.hypothesis: Единая модель голов команды gives a lower exact-score log loss than production (Poisson + reconciliation with the 1X2 classifier) without worse totals / BTTS / handicap probabilities and without a lower Main ROI.

exact_rule.model: one XGBoost count:poisson model of a team's goals (experiments/v6_3/goals/base.py, stage_stacked): two rows per match (home team vs away team with is_home = 1, away team vs home team with is_home = 0); features = production home_goals ∪ away_goals sets mapped to team (t_) / opponent (o_), diff_* and elo_diff negated and elo_exp_home = 1 − x for the away row; production away_goals hyper-parameters (449 trees), recency half-life 2 years, trained once on every season before the predicted one
exact_rule.matrix: production: independent Poisson + reconciliation with the production 1X2 classifier

entries.primary_metric: exact-score log loss, paired with production on the same forward matches
secondary: Main ROI vs Baseline B (close and t09)
entries.minimum_forward_sample: 1500 played matches (about 7 weeks of the 21 leagues)
